d: Project WAHED is the Qatar Airways Group's ERP transformation across the whole Group. It covers Retail, Hospitality, Finance, Supply Chain and HR across the Group's businesses.

We are seeking an ERP Transformation Manager – Retail to own the Retail Front of House discipline for Project WAHED. You will be the single accountable business owner for the store-facing retail platform: Oracle Retail Xstore Point of Sale, Xstore Office and XOCS, plus the related store technology estate. You will also own all Front of House data, testing and validation through to go-live and post-go-live support. You will help connect store and digital channels, including order orchestration with eCommerce, so customers get one consistent experience across every channel.
q: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent with a minimum of 6 years of job-related experience
Direct experience with Oracle Retail Xstore Point of Sale / Xstore Office / XOCS, or an equivalent enterprise point of sale platform
6+ years in retail store operations or retail technology, with direct ownership of point of sale and store back-office systems
5+ years in business transformation and ERP implementation
Delivery through the full implementation lifecycle (data migration, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare) in a live trading environment
Hands-on test management experience: scenario design, script writing and review, test data, defect management and formal exit sign-off
Experience managing multi-site rollouts at scale, including deployment sequencing, site readiness and post-deployment support
Experience leading cross-functional process improvement projects
Experience with process mapping and process flow analysis tools
Experience with Oracle Retail Order Orchestration Cloud Service / Order Broker Cloud Service (OROB), or an equivalent distributed order management platform
Omnichannel retail experience, such as click and collect, ship-from-store, endless aisle, cross-channel returns, and store-to-eCommerce inventory visibility and fulfilment
Professional certifications in Oracle ERP or Oracle Retail
5+ years directly leading ERP implementations and rollouts
Experience of travel retail, duty-free or airport retail operations
Experience with project management or Agile delivery in a regulated environment
Data and access governance experience, and experience implementing dashboards and KPI reporting
Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor clear, concise messages for every audience, from the store floor to executives
Ability to work effectively across business, IT and systems integrator partners
Comfortable working under pressure against fixed delivery milestones
r: Own the Retail Front of House solution end to end, from build to steady state. This covers Xstore Point of Sale, Xstore Office/XOCS, till hardware, peripherals, payment integration and related store technology.
Lead Front of House data migration across all conversion cycles: object ownership, cleansing, load validation, reconciliation and formal sign-off of converted data.

Own the Front of House test agenda across integration, user acceptance, security and operational testing. This includes scenario coverage, scripts, test data, oversight of test runs, defect triage and exit sign-off.
Write, review and challenge test scripts and validation approaches so that testing proves the stores can operate, not just that the system works.
Represent Front of House in design authority and change control forums, and explain the store operating model clearly to business, IT and delivery partner stakeholders.
Drive cutover and go-live readiness for stores. This includes till readiness, the rollback position, protecting day-one trading and the hypercare support model.
Plan and manage a high-volume point of sale rollout across a large, multi-site store estate, timing deployment around trading peaks and store operating constraints.

Support the omnichannel order flows between stores and eCommerce, such as click and collect, ship-from-store, store fulfilment and returns, working with Oracle Retail Order Orchestration Cloud Service / Order Broker Cloud Service (OROB).
Partner with Store Operations, Finance, IT, Loyalty, eCommerce and the systems integrator to close solution dependencies.
Lead change, training readiness and super-user enablement for the store population alongside the Change workstream.
Manage risks, issues and dependencies for the discipline, escalating with clear options and recommendations.
Perform other department duties related to the position as directed by the Head of the Department.

d: Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

We're looking for an experienced payroll specialist to join Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations team. We are rapidly expanding Rippling to serve the needs of employees and employers all over the world. Our Global Payroll Operations team plays a critical role in ensuring the success of our global payroll products, which are natively built and fully integrated with Rippling’s broader suite of products.

As Rippling expands its product offerings globally, there is a critical business need for Rippling to develop new muscles around global product operations and country-specific payroll expertise outside of the US.

This role, Global Payroll Operations Specialist, is a critical hire for the Global Payroll Operations team that will be fully dedicated to developing and executing these new capabilities. This role will own all operational aspects across select countries, relationships with our external partners, and drive our expansion into new customer segments and geographies. Additionally, this role brings critical country-specific payroll expertise to support the development of our natively built payroll software.
This is an exciting role that requires significant cross-departmental engagement with a major impact on the product and customer experience.
q: Minimum of 5+ years in a UAE payroll processing role, and ideally 2+ years in a client facing role
Bonus if you have experience running payroll in other EMEA countries.
Process payroll activities in accordance with company guidelines, social security, legislations and local taxes requirements.
Experience with Google Suite or Microsoft Office, especially Docs/Sheets/Excel, for data analysis and task organisation; familiarity with Salesforce queues, JIRA, and Confluence a plus
Ability to review and validate calculations
Must have understanding of payroll concepts
Has working experience with payroll related systems and software
Deep understanding of the leave entitlements
Strong organisational skills and able to work under strict deadlines
Fluent in Arabic and English - written and spoken
Please apply with CV in English
r: Execute timely payroll, filings, and payments for all customers across key countries
Drive issue resolution and communication with various government agencies and partners; you will directly interface with our customers and resolve issues on their behalf
Work closely with Global Payroll Engineering and Product teams to ensure that:
Natively built payroll software supports key payroll and tax compliance requirements
Product bugs and product issues (e.g., calculation errors, file generation errors) are quickly addressed
Internal tooling requirements are properly prioritised and implemented

d: Company Description 3C Medical Company, founded in 2015, focuses on enhancing experiences for patients and healthcare providers through Communication, Collaboration, and Care. The company manages a broad portfolio of high-quality medical equipment and devices sourced from leading multinational, research-based partners. Its commercial operations are driven by a talented, ambitious team supported by responsive market services. 3C Medical Company offers a healthy business environment and aims to provide the best services to local customers across all market segments. The organization is committed to being “Best In Business,” operating with high professional and ethical standards and striving to make a positive impact in everything it does.

Role Description The Medical Regulatory Affairs Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Kuwait. This role oversees regulatory compliance for medical equipment and devices, ensuring that all products meet local and international regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities include preparing, submitting, and maintaining regulatory documentation, tracking approvals, and managing product registrations and renewals. The supervisor collaborates with internal departments and external partners to interpret regulatory guidelines, support audits and inspections, and implement regulatory strategies that enable timely market access. The role also involves monitoring regulatory changes, training relevant teams on compliance requirements, and contributing to continuous improvement of regulatory processes and quality standards.
q: Strong knowledge of medical device regulations, registration processes, and compliance standards in Kuwait and relevant international markets.
Experience in preparing, reviewing, and managing regulatory submissions, technical files, and product registration dossiers.
Background in quality management systems, documentation control, and participation in audits and inspections.
Ability to interpret regulatory guidelines, analyze risk, and develop practical solutions and regulatory strategies.
Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams, external partners, and regulatory authorities.
Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field; advanced degree or professional certification in Regulatory Affairs is an advantage.
Relevant experience in regulatory affairs within the medical devices or healthcare sector, preferably in a supervisory or lead capacity.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Proficiency in English; Arabic language skills are an advantage.

d: The Senior Compliance officer is responsible of carrying out detailed analysis, review and report on the end-to-end different processes on SAP in accordance with policies, procedures, industry best practices.
q: Relevant working experience, in compliance, risk & internal audit.
Knowledge, understanding and experience in the stated field processes, fraud and / or compliance.
Knowledge and understanding in risk and compliance management.
Knowledge and understanding on planning, material master data, material consumption, inventory management, etc.
Knowledge and understanding of vendor sourcing and management.
Knowledge of logistics and warehousing management.
Knowledge and understanding of Primavera and SAP systems which includes planning.
Demonstrated skills in MS Office Suites, presentation, communication (verbal and written) and analysis.
r: Identify areas of compliance – company policies and procedures, regulatory requirements, etc.
Conduct functional analyses and reviews on Cost Control to identify areas of non-compliance and advise mitigations to address non-compliance.
Investigate reports with compliance issues, irregularities, and violations.
Communicate non-compliance with respective departments and ensure corrective actions are complied with.
Ensure tracking tools are maintained and that these are sufficient to act as an audit trail for the purposes of internal or other audits/investigations.
Advise and create process and system improvements based on investigations and observations.
Monitor standards that ensure that all records and documents are maintained according to policies and procedures.
Follow up on recommendations for non-compliance in relation to the timeframe for implementation.
Monitor performance by updating performance scorecard issuance monthly.
Plan and coordinate training on compliance matters as required and recommended.

Notify policy custodians (through official channels) of any suggested changes to improve policies and procedures. Review new draft policies and procedures to identify significant compliance weaknesses.
Keep updated on changes in regulations, legislation, policies and procedures that may affect the organization and compliance reviews.
